messages:
Marta: Quick sync 1 AcmeCorp POC asking for BYO HSM + daily rotation + SOC2 evidence. Need perf delta, sample SOW language for 'no vendor fallback', and a tight quote. Can someone own?
Ethan: I can draft SOW lines. Clarify: they require every encrypt to hit HSM (no session tokens)?
Marta: Yes, auditor said per-op must be logged.
Ravi: Perf note: per-op proxied HSM calls commonly add ~815ms median and ~2540ms p95 in our testing, depends on region and peering. If they want daily rotation, recommend a canary window and keep previous KEK for decrypt-only to avoid rewrap costs.
Nina: For SOC/attestation: we can provide HSM attestation acceptance steps and a short Q/A. Quick canned answer: 'Redwood never stores unwrapped customer key material; we operate on wrapped keys and accept vendor attestation certs.'
Ethan: Pricing proposal for POC: $1,000 setup + $0.02 per 1k proxied ops (single-region). Add $0.01/1k for active-active multi-region. Mark as draft.
Marta: Procure wants a line to state 'no vendor-managed fallback unless explicitly contracted' in SOW. Ethan pls add it.
Ravi: Runbook snippet to paste: '1) Customer provisions new KEK in HSM and shares attestation. 2) Redwood ingests wrapped KEK. 3) Route small percentage traffic for 10m. 4) Monitor; if <1% errors, full cutover. 5) Retain previous KEK for decrypt-only.'
Nina: I'll prepare an attestation checklist and attach SOC excerpts.
procure-bot: Uploaded: acme_poc_requirements_2026-03-22.pdf
Marta: Thanks. Action: Ethan SOW + price, Ravi perf numbers and one-line runbook, Nina attestation Qs. I'll bundle and send to Acme.
Ethan: I'll drop SOW draft in the drive in 2 hours.
Marta: Great. Closing for now :ok_hand:
